text: A common rule-of-thumb starting value for the spectral radius in ESN design is rho ~ ___.
explanation: The chapters recommend setting rho(W_rec) ~ 0.9 as a default starting point (the esn.py docstring likewise notes rho ~ 0.9-0.95), just below the ESP boundary so memory is long while the reservoir stays contractive. Tune upward for long-memory tasks, downward for instantaneous ones.
